  • Core is read from the Major tag on your year sheet. Everything you load stays editable — remove or switch sections at any time.
  • Credits are not in the view. There is no credit column, so no credit total is displayed. Contact hours are shown instead and are a schedule measure only.
  • Eligibility can only be partly verified. The dataset records the Major / Major Elective / CCC / UWE tag per programme-year sheet and an “open as UWE” flag, and six courses state a restriction in words. There is no programme-restriction, minor, UK-elective or BS-elective field, so eligibility beyond those tags cannot be confirmed here — check with your department before registering.
